mechanistic_diagnosis.primary: Q_psi has a regime-specific ranking failure, especially around own_flag_stolen

evidence_D1A.interpretation: Phase-0 fit data over-represented stolen/carrying relative to D0 z1|B; absence/rarity is ruled out as the dominant explanation.

evidence_D1B.interpretation: Localized stolen-flag failure materially depresses the aggregate worst-quartile picture (0.709 -> 0.823).

mechanistic_diagnosis.combined_story: Most of the strategic-ranking signal is reasonably aligned, but the scorer becomes systematically unreliable in a particular high-pressure game regime. Separately, even where the scorer is mostly right, the policy still shows evidence of optimization/interference failing to preserve that signal reliably in the intended latent.
